    About

    I'm Mudasir Hussain, a Computer Science graduate (BS CS, Iqra University, 2024) and AI-Assisted Developer based in Mirpurkhas, Sindh, Pakistan.

    I build websites and apps with modern AI development tools — Codex, Claude Code and Muse AI — turning ideas into working, polished products. My development work is grounded in real business experience, not just code.

    Before and alongside development, I spent 4 years in e-commerce operations: managing a Shopify store and its product catalog for a UAE-based brand, and doing Amazon keyword research and product ranking at Proxy Marketing. That mix means the websites I build are made to sell, and the stores I manage are run with a developer's eye for detail.
